name: element.searchFields
title: List search fields
summary: The fields a search can be restricted to, each with its key and name, for choosing the fields of element.search.
details: Title, text, IDs and all properties first, then each property of the metamodel that a type of the workspace's elements has, in metamodel order: one that holds no relations and is not the title. A property whose key is `title`, `text`, `id` or `properties` is not listed, since that key names the fixed field. Every listed key is a value element.search `fields` takes.

fields.description: The fields in the order above.

key.description: What element.search `fields` takes: `title`, `text`, `id`, `properties` or the key of a property.

name.description: The name: of the title property for `title` ("Title" without one), "Text", "IDs", "All properties", else the property's name in the metamodel.
